entities.summary: Nicola Barbato was a Sicilian medical doctor, socialist, and politician. He was one of the national leaders of the Fasci Siciliani dei Lavoratori a popular movement of democratic and socialist inspiration in 1891–1894, and perhaps might have been the ablest among them according to the journalist Adolfo Rossi and Marxist historian Eric Hobsbawm.
